transcript.text: Let me search for the relevant SailPoint ISC API tools for submitting access requests.

Here's how to submit an access request via the ISC API.

## `POST /v3/access-requests`

### Required body fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `requestedFor` | `string[]` | Identity IDs of the users receiving access |
| `requestedItems` | `object[]` | The access items being requested |

Each entry in `requestedItems` needs:
- `type` — `ACCESS_PROFILE`, `ROLE`, or `ENTITLEMENT`
- `id` — the ID of the access profile / role / entitlement
- `comment` *(optional)* — justification comment

### Example request

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "requestedFor": ["2c9180858082150f0180893dbaf44201"],
  "requestType": "GRANT_ACCESS",
  "requestedItems": [
    {
      "type": "ACCESS_PROFILE",
      "id": "2c9180858082150f0180893dbaf55555",
      "comment": "Needed for project Orion onboarding"
    }
  ]
}
```

To request a **role** or **entitlement** instead, just change `type`:

```json
{ "type": "ROLE",        "id": "<role-id>" }
{ "type": "ENTITLEMENT", "id": "<entitlement-id>" }
```

### `requestType` values

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `GRANT_ACCESS` *(default)* | Add the access |
| `REVOKE_ACCESS` | Remove the access |

### Scopes

Your OAuth token needs **one** of:
- `idn:access-request:manage` — full access request management (ORG_ADMIN)
- `idn:access-request-self:manage` — request access on behalf of self only (USER)

Use `idn:access-request:manage` when submitting on behalf of another user.

### cURL example

```bash
curl -X POST "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "requestedFor": ["<identity-id>"],
    "requestType": "GRANT_ACCESS",
    "requestedItems": [
      {
        "type": "ACCESS_PROFILE",
        "id": "<access-profile-id>",
        "comment": "Requesting access for user onboarding"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

The API returns `202 Accepted` on success — the request then flows through any configured approval workflows in ISC.

```answer-summary
endpoints:
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/access-requests
    api_version: v3
auth_flow: OAuth2 bearer token
required_scopes: [idn:access-request:manage, idn:access-request-self:manage]
key_parameters: [requestedFor, requestedItems, requestType, type, id, comment]
```
